_comment: Curated character catalog. Wardrobes name the AUTHENTIC kit including crest, name and number — measured to render cleanly, and the specificity is what makes a frame look like real footage. reference_images are AI stills from `python -m app.video.catalog_build`, generated with the SAME image model used for scene keyframes.
